note: CURATION.md admission rule 2 requires every catalogue entry to build for both supported architectures, or to carry a deliberately labelled official web fallback for the missing one. These entries meet neither, and are acknowledged here rather than discovered by a person on the wrong machine. The shell no longer OFFERS an application this device cannot install (Services/Catalog.qml filters on the architecture punard publishes in status.json), so the cost of an entry on this list is that the application is absent on that architecture — not that it is offered and then refused, which is the bug this list was written after.
